subject.title: improve(ui): nest Settings pages under /settings routes

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/settings/*` as the canonical Control UI Settings URL namespace while keeping the existing top-level paths as aliases?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but canonical URL structure is user-visible product direction and the PR does not show maintainer-confirmed intent.

options.title: Accept `/settings/*` after proof
options.body: Treat `/settings/*` as canonical, keep the legacy aliases, and require real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into the broader Settings layout PR
options.body: Defer this route namespace decision until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100936 settles the adjacent Settings navigation direction.

options.title: Keep top-level Settings routes
options.body: Decline the namespace change for now and keep `/config`, `/appearance`, and sibling routes as canonical.

recommendation.title: Accept `/settings/*` after proof
recommendation.body: Treat `/settings/*` as canonical, keep the legacy aliases, and require real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI sidebar and route work makes this the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
